units.source_text: 而從P（我記得這是稱呼黨的暗語，或許有記錯）那兒又不斷地下達新任務，

en.t: And from P, which I remember was a secret way of referring to the Party, though I may be mistaken, new assignments kept coming down one after another,

units.source_text: 忙得連喘息的時間都沒有。

en.t: I was so busy that I did not even have time to catch my breath.

units.source_text: 我虛弱多病的身體越來越吃不消了。

en.t: My frail, sickly body was becoming less and less able to endure it.

units.source_text: 本來我只是因為對「非法」感興趣才參加了這個地下運動，

en.t: Originally, I had joined this underground movement only because I was interested in the illicit,

units.source_text: 沒想到卻假戲真做，手忙腳亂得不可開交，

en.t: but before I knew it, the playacting had become real, and I was overwhelmed and frantic,

units.source_text: 我不禁在心中暗暗對P這幫人抱怨：你們找錯人了吧？

en.t: I could not help secretly grumbling to the people of P in my heart: you have picked the wrong man, have you not?

units.source_text: 這些任務怎麼不交給你們的嫡系成員去做呢？

en.t: Why do you not give these tasks to your own direct members to do?
And so, I chose to run away.

units.source_text: 逃避果然令我難受，我有時真想一死了之。

en.t: Running away did indeed torment me, and at times I truly wanted to die and have done with it.

units.source_text: 那時，有三個女人對我特別有好感，其中一位是我寄宿的仙遊館老闆的女兒。

en.t: At that time, there were three women who were especially fond of me, and one of them was the daughter of the owner of Senyukan, where I was lodging.
